paragraphs.own_finite_claim_limit: Ayame’s admired position is analyzed without assigning all original private motives.

paragraphs.section: An answer at the castle
paragraphs.complete_literal_paragraph: **AYAME-P015.** The juniors make this relation possible without merging into one approving chorus. Kikyou wants Nagusa herself while retaining resentment and later consents to witness. Renge wants reunion and apology; Yukari's chosen membership survives hurt. Their cooperation and later exposure of fears have different owners and costs. They can support Nagusa's approach to Ayame, but none can turn group affection into Ayame's awakened agreement. Keeping their directions distinct also preserves the difficulty of repairing relationships after attention, truth or care has been withheld. [A01:26,28,48,52,62; A02:48,50,57]
paragraphs.argument_meaning: The juniors make this relation possible without merging into one approving chorus. Kikyou wants Nagusa herself while retaining resentment and later consents to witness. Renge wants reunion and apology; Yukari's chosen membership survives hurt. Their cooperation and later exposure of fears have different owners and costs. They can support Nagusa's approach to Ayame, but none can turn group affection into Ayame's awakened agreement. paragraphs.attribution_modes: Distinct junior wishes, witness and coerced fear
paragraphs.own_authoring_question: How do peers support without surrogate assent?
paragraphs.own_serious_contrary: Collective junior approval erases Kikyou’s resentment, Renge’s apology wish and Yukari’s chosen hurt membership.
paragraphs.own_finite_claim_limit: Directed support is retained; no awakened Ayame agreement supplied by others.

paragraphs.own_finite_claim_limit: Retain meaningful participant role without total solution or private dyad.

paragraphs.own_serious_contrary: A no-change reading erases body/arm return; a total-restoration reading erases continuing sleep.
paragraphs.own_finite_claim_limit: Positive bodily endpoint distinct from mental, identity and reciprocal restoration.

paragraphs.own_serious_contrary: A doctor report is mediated; forcing cure or consent from sleep would fabricate the recipient’s response.
paragraphs.own_finite_claim_limit: No chart/prognosis/awakening inference; refusal to force awakening remains Nagusa’s choice.

paragraphs.section: A body returned, a response withheld
paragraphs.attribution_modes: Actual Nagusa waiting/gardening around sleeping Ayame

paragraphs.own_serious_contrary: Smallness is no exclusion; another’s care does not establish Ayame’s hobby or reciprocal success.
paragraphs.own_finite_claim_limit: Preserve the achieved care and its actual owner without clinical/friendship completion.

paragraphs.section: A body returned, a response withheld

paragraphs.own_serious_contrary: Held dissolution, two different bouts, title speech and body return concern different authority questions.
paragraphs.own_finite_claim_limit: Ayame role matters without printed formal office/emblem/funding restoration.

paragraphs.section: A body returned, a response withheld

paragraphs.own_serious_contrary: Joy/song and new writing work locally, while different actors and retracted rules prevent total mechanics.
paragraphs.own_finite_claim_limit: Local setting effects illuminate but do not certify original agency over every monster/book.

paragraphs.section: A body returned, a response withheld
paragraphs.attribution_modes: Official account plus distinct written representation modes
paragraphs.own_authoring_question: Can one label or public explanation certify all Ayame speech?
paragraphs.own_serious_contrary: Public simplification and log/dream/italic seams have different interests and grades.

paragraphs.own_serious_contrary: Both shared recognition and hostile fabrication have actual warrants; each totalization suppresses local counterevidence.
paragraphs.own_finite_claim_limit: No whole merger/split/ontology denial; local acts retain meaning.

paragraphs.section: What recognition can leave open
paragraphs.attribution_modes: Role, indifference and warm-completion rivals
paragraphs.own_authoring_question: Which readings erase the particular goods and missing responses?
paragraphs.own_serious_contrary: Ideal office, never-cared verdict and complete healing each take one scene beyond its evidence.
paragraphs.own_finite_claim_limit: Retain praise burden, contested report, apology, return and care as different finite goods.

paragraphs.section: What recognition can leave open
paragraphs.attribution_modes: Connected conclusion over mode-bounded goods
paragraphs.own_authoring_question: What remains valuable without forcing an answer?
paragraphs.own_serious_contrary: Uncertainty is neither proof of empty care nor permission to speak for returned Ayame.
paragraphs.own_finite_claim_limit: End on her unshown present response, not a technical stage or future certainty.
